title: Anti LoveStrukTrap
features:
# v. 1.0

-- What's it?
This script is for the survivors. 

Is a script that will create a button GUI (+ credits, will last just 6 seconds) that when will be "ON" it will permit you to not be affected by the Love Struck Trap of piggy [ new trap ], that is one of the most OP traps of the game.

--How to use?
JUST ACTIVE IT. 
❗Important thing: will take some seconds to load the entire script (2-4 seconds)❗

-- Why use this script?
Because this is the only one available and the only one that cancels all effect of the Love Struck Trap.
❗It disable all effects of the trap, disable the camera rotation (the most annoying thing) and disable the slowness that give the trap.❗ (Everything about the trap)

# made by AcelestuZ
